process CLEANIFIER_DOWNLOAD {
    tag "${meta.id}"
    label 'process_medium'

    conda "${moduleDir}/environment.yml"
    container "${workflow.containerEngine in ['singularity', 'apptainer'] && !task.ext.singularity_pull_docker_container
        ? 'https://depot.galaxyproject.org/singularity/cleanifier:1.3.2--pyhdfd78af_0'
        : 'quay.io/biocontainers/cleanifier:1.3.2--pyhdfd78af_0'}"

    input:
    tuple val(meta), val(version)

    output:
    tuple val(meta), path("*.{filter,hash}"), emit: index
    tuple val(meta), path("*.info"), emit: info
    tuple val("${task.process}"), val('cleanifier'), eval("cleanifier --version"), emit: versions_cleanifier, topic: versions

    when:
    task.ext.when == null || task.ext.when

    script:
    def args = task.ext.args ?: ''
    """
    cleanifier download \\
        --version ${version} \\
        --dir . \\
        ${args}

    rm *.tar
    """

    stub:
    def suffix = (version == "exact") ? "hash" : "filter"
    """
    touch index.${suffix}
    touch index.info
    """
}

---
name: "nf-core/cleanifier/download"
description: "Download human reference index"
keywords:
- "download"
- "index"
- "metagenomics"
- "contamination removal"
- "microbiome"
tools:
- cleanifier:
    description: "A fast lightweight tool to remove contamination using k-mers."
    homepage: "https://gitlab.com/rahmannlab/cleanifier"
    documentation: "https://gitlab.com/rahmannlab/cleanifier"
    tool_dev_url: "https://gitlab.com/rahmannlab/cleanifier"
    doi: "10.1093/bioinformatics/btaf632"
    licence:
    - "MIT"
    identifier: "biotools:cleanifier"
input:
- - meta:
      type: "map"
      description: "Groovy Map containing sample information\ne.g. `[ id:'sample1'\
        \ ]`\n"
  - version:
      type: "string"
      description: "The version of the index to download.\nOptions: 'probabilistic'\
        \ (default) or 'exact'\n"
output:
  index:
  - - meta:
        type: "map"
        description: "Groovy Map containing sample information\ne.g. `[ id:'human_index'\
          \ ]`\n"
    - '*.{filter,hash}':
        type: "file"
        description: "The main index file (Cuckoo filter or hash table)."
        pattern: "*.{filter,hash}"
        ontologies: []
  info:
  - - meta:
        type: "map"
        description: "Groovy Map containing sample information\ne.g. `[ id:'human_index'\
          \ ]`\n"
    - '*.info':
        type: "file"
        description: "Metadata file containing index parameters."
        pattern: "*.info"
        ontologies: []
  versions_cleanifier:
  - - ${task.process}:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the process"
    - cleanifier:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the tool"
    - cleanifier --version:
        type: "eval"
        description: "The expression to obtain the version of the tool"
topics:
  versions:
  - - ${task.process}:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the process"
    - cleanifier:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the tool"
    - cleanifier --version:
        type: "eval"
        description: "The expression to obtain the version of the tool"
authors:
- "@LeonHornich"
maintainers:
- "@LeonHornich"
version: "0.0.0-6d1763b"
